Workshop on

12–14 October 2026 IIT Bombay, Powai, Mumbai

About the workshop

The workshop covers advanced Single-Particle Analysis (SPA) workflows, including high-resolution structure determination and troubleshooting. It will also provide a complete Cryo-ET pipeline.
